briefings.title: Industry Role Shortlist

scope.geography: United States; Cleveland/Ohio prioritized when a sufficiently strong industry match is available
focus: Complex in vitro and preclinical models
Tissue engineering, bioprinting, microfluidics, and medical-device-adjacent R&D
R&D scientist, translational biology, and assay development
scope.selection_rule: Current actionable roles only; exclude stale postings, generic biomedical roles, and matches that do not materially use the candidate's organ-chip, wet-lab, bioinformatics, CFD, or fabrication background.

candidate_profile_snapshot.headline: Biomedical engineering PhD candidate integrating experimental biology, computational fluid dynamics, and bioinformatics in human-relevant microphysiological systems.
core_strengths: Stretchable microfluidic gut-on-a-chip and multiplex organ-on-a-chip platforms
Patient-derived intestinal organoids and host-microbiome co-culture
Crohn's disease, inflammation, oxidative stress, radiation injury, fibrosis, and barrier dysfunction models
Single-cell and bulk RNA-seq, 16S analysis, pathway interpretation, and biological data integration
Computational fluid dynamics and transport modeling
Porous PDMS membrane fabrication, photolithography, soft lithography, additive manufacturing, and 3D printing
Translational NAMs and human-relevant alternatives to conventional animal testing
Wet-lab assay development, microscopy, barrier/function assays, molecular biology, advanced cell culture, troubleshooting, and experimental design

jobs.title: Scientist II, Complex In Vitro Model
jobs.company_info: AbbVie is a global biopharmaceutical company. This Worcester Immunology opening sits specifically in a Complex In Vitro Model group supporting inflammatory and autoimmune drug discovery with human-relevant systems.
jobs.posting_status: Current listing found; surfaced as newly posted in August 2026
jobs.job_description: Design, execute, and interpret in vitro studies for drug-candidate characterization and target validation using primary human cells and complex human models including organoids and organ-on-chip systems.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong experimental cell-biology background
Ability to design and interpret quantitative biochemical and cellular studies
Experience working with primary human cells and advanced in vitro model systems
Clear scientific communication and collaborative drug-discovery mindset
preferred_requirements: Omics-informed interpretation of complex biological systems
jobs.why_good_match: This is the cleanest current industry translation of the website profile. The role explicitly values complex human in vitro models, organoids and organ-on-chip systems, while the candidate adds Crohn's/inflammation biology, patient-derived organoids, barrier assays, microfluidics, scRNA-seq and engineering depth.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Host-microbiome effects on inflammation and barrier function
Barrier, ROS, imaging and molecular readouts
gaps_or_risks: Direct pharmaceutical target-validation experience may be lighter than candidates already in industry
Immunology experience is strong in an intestinal context but not necessarily broad across systemic immune-cell assays
resume_tailoring: Lead with complex human in vitro model development, not device fabrication
Describe Crohn's and microbiome work as inflammatory-disease and target/pathway interrogation
Put organoids, organ-on-chip, primary human biology and quantitative endpoints in the first half page
Use CFD and fabrication as differentiators rather than the headline
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply this week. Build the resume around one narrative: develop human-relevant complex models, perturb them, quantify function and molecular response, and use the data to explain disease biology.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - 3D Bioprinting
jobs.company_info: Polbionica is a regenerative-medicine biotechnology company expanding at LabCentral in Cambridge. It develops an integrated 3D-bioprinting platform and biomaterials including extracellular-matrix-derived bioinks.
jobs.job_description: Hands-on regenerative-medicine R&D using 3D bioprinting, cell culture, biomaterials and tissue-engineering workflows. The employer explicitly states that prior 3D-bioprinting experience is not required if the candidate has strong adjacent biotechnology or tissue-engineering experience.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong hands-on laboratory research capability
Background in biotechnology, cell biology, cell culture, tissue engineering, biomaterials or a related field
Willingness to learn and operate new fabrication technologies
Comfort in a small, rapidly developing R&D environment
jobs.why_good_match: This role converts the candidate's 3D-printing and microfabrication experience from a side skill into a central asset while still using engineered tissues and wet-lab biology. The porous PDMS membrane and organ-chip fabrication work provide unusually concrete evidence of building biological hardware rather than merely using it.
gaps_or_risks: Direct extrusion/droplet/volumetric bioprinting may be limited
Bioink formulation and biomaterials chemistry may be less developed than microfluidic fabrication
resume_tailoring: Create a fabrication-forward resume
Show device images or a one-page portfolio with chips, membranes and 3D-printed prototypes
Put cell culture and tissue biology next to fabrication bullets so the profile reads as biofabrication, not hobbyist printing
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply now and include a compact visual portfolio. This is one of the rare openings where showing what you physically built could materially improve the application.

jobs.title: Principal Microfluidics Engineer
jobs.company_info: Draper is an independent nonprofit R&D organization working across national-security and biomedical engineering programs. Its bioengineering work includes microfluidics, cell and tissue engineering, and organ-on-chip systems.

salary.note: Current posted base-pay range across U.S. locations/levels.

jobs.job_description: Lead microfluidic R&D: design, model, fabricate, characterize and test devices for cell and tissue engineering applications; plan cellular assays; contribute to proposals; mentor engineers; and support hands-on laboratory operations.
key_must_have_requirements: Expertise in microfabrication and microfluidic device design, fabrication and testing
Advanced engineering degree
Hands-on laboratory capability
Ability to lead teams and mentor engineers
Ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance
jobs.why_good_match: Technically, this is almost a mirror of the engineering half of the portfolio: microfluidic design, CFD, fabrication, organ-on-chip, cell/tissue assays and multidisciplinary development. The mismatch is level rather than content.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Soft lithography and porous membrane fabrication
gaps_or_risks: Principal-level leadership expectations may exceed a graduating PhD profile
Government-clearance eligibility is a hard practical requirement
Flow cytometry may not be a central demonstrated technique
resume_tailoring: Present projects as engineering programs with requirements, design decisions, validation and outcomes
Quantify fabrication performance and model validation
Bring invention/prototyping work forward
Signal openness to appropriate leveling if the principal title is too senior
jobs.immediate_action_now: Check clearance eligibility first. If eligible, apply as a stretch and explicitly state openness to a Scientist/Engineer level if Draper sees the technical fit but not the principal-level tenure.

jobs.title: In Vitro Biologist - Cardiovascular & Renal Research
jobs.company_info: Lilly's Cardiovascular and Renal Research group integrates in vitro biology and translational science to advance small molecules, biologics and genetic medicines.
jobs.job_description: Hands-on preclinical biology role developing and validating disease-relevant cell-based assays, introducing new assay technologies, and supporting target/pathway characterization across cardiovascular and renal discovery programs.
key_must_have_requirements: Hands-on cell biology and biochemical experimentation
Ability to independently develop and validate cellular assays
Molecular readouts such as RNA/DNA analysis and protein-expression assays
Cross-functional scientific collaboration
U.S. work authorization without employer visa sponsorship for this role
preferred_requirements: Flow cytometry and diverse assay-detection technologies
Automation or AI in preclinical research
jobs.why_good_match: The disease area differs, but the work pattern is familiar: build a disease-relevant cell model, perturb it, validate assays, quantify pathway responses and troubleshoot. The candidate's bioinformatics capability is an extra differentiator because Lilly explicitly values computational familiarity.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Rapid troubleshooting of complex cell systems
gaps_or_risks: No direct cardiovascular/renal specialization
Some preferred techniques such as FACS, SPR, SEC or in vivo pharmacology may be limited
The title may be leveled below or differently from PhD Scientist conventions
resume_tailoring: Use an assay-development resume rather than an organ-chip-engineering resume
Translate chip readouts into disease-relevant cellular assay language
Emphasize independent model optimization, controls and reproducibility
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply if the work-authorization requirement is compatible. Tailor the first project bullets around assay development and mechanistic biology rather than device novelty.

jobs.title: Scientist, HIV Virology
jobs.company_info: Parallel Bio is building human-first drug discovery using immune organoids and AI as an alternative to poorly predictive animal models. The company is developing human organoid platforms for immunology and translational drug discovery.
jobs.job_description: Build Parallel Bio's HIV program from the ground up, establishing equipment, SOPs, BSL2+ practices and validated virology assays on a human immune-organoid platform.
key_must_have_requirements: Current or recent HIV virology postdoctoral-level expertise
Years of BSL2+ experience
Deep familiarity with HIV viral-load, infectivity, latency, neutralization, integration and replication assays
Strong immunology and T-cell biology
Bench-first experimental ownership
preferred_requirements: Single-cell, multi-omic or high-content imaging readouts
Comfort working with hardware engineers and platform scientists
jobs.why_good_match: The company mission and platform are exceptionally aligned with human-relevant organoid/NAM research, and the candidate already brings organoids, single-cell data and hardware-biology integration. However, this specific opening is fundamentally an HIV-virologist hire, so platform fit cannot substitute for the hard virology requirement.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Working across biology and engineered platforms
gaps_or_risks: HIV virology is a central hard requirement
BSL2+ HIV assay experience may be absent
This is a high-concept fit but potentially a low credential fit if virology experience is missing
resume_tailoring: Do not disguise the HIV gap
If applying, lead with human organoid/NAM platform development and ability to build experimental systems from scratch
Use this company as a high-priority networking target even if this exact role is too specialized
jobs.immediate_action_now: Do not spend hours on a formal application unless you can credibly meet the HIV/BSL2+ requirements. Instead, contact or follow Parallel Bio and watch for platform-scientist or organoid-scientist openings; the company itself is an unusually strong target.

jobs.title: Sr. Scientist, Therapeutics & Translational Bioinformatics
jobs.company_info: Moderna is an mRNA medicines company. This translational-bioinformatics position supports therapeutic discovery and early development using human, clinical, preclinical and in vitro multi-omic datasets.
jobs.posting_status: Current employer posting; posted in August 2026
jobs.job_description: Lead computational strategy and integrated multi-omics analyses across translational and therapeutic programs, including bulk/single-cell transcriptomics, human and preclinical data, biomarkers and machine-learning approaches.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD in a quantitative or computational biomedical discipline
Strong R and/or Python programming
Hands-on bulk and single-cell transcriptomics
Integrated multi-omics analysis
Ability to lead computational strategy for multidisciplinary programs
jobs.why_good_match: The candidate's scRNA-seq, pseudobulk, pathway analysis and experimental biology create a useful wet-lab-to-computation perspective. The role is attractive if computational biology becomes a primary career lane rather than a supporting skill.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Linking omics signatures to engineered-tissue phenotypes
gaps_or_risks: The posting expects deeper full-time computational leadership than a hybrid wet-lab profile usually demonstrates
TCR/BCR and advanced ML may be gaps
The role commonly expects postdoctoral or relevant industry experience
resume_tailoring: Lead with computational biology and omics; move organ-chip engineering to the differentiator section
List pipelines, languages, dataset types and analysis outputs explicitly
Show that analyses drove biological decisions rather than serving only as visualization
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply only with a dedicated computational CV and a public code/analysis portfolio. A generic organ-chip resume will be screened out quickly.

jobs.title: Sr. Scientist; Bioinformatic and Translational Science
jobs.company_info: Fore Biotherapeutics is a precision-oncology company developing biomarker-driven therapies. This role leads computational analysis of genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and clinical datasets for biomarker discovery and patient stratification.
jobs.job_description: Lead computational pipelines and biological interpretation across large-scale genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and clinical datasets to support biomarkers, patient stratification and translational development.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong computational analysis of large biological datasets
Bioinformatics pipeline development
Genomics/transcriptomics and translational interpretation
Strong written and virtual cross-functional communication
Ability to work successfully in a regulated remote environment
jobs.why_good_match: This uses the candidate's bioinformatics and translational interpretation while valuing someone who understands where biological phenotypes come from. It uses far less of the microfluidics/fabrication profile than the top roles, so it is best viewed as a deliberate computational pivot.
gaps_or_risks: Oncology-specific experience is limited
Clinical and proteomic data may be gaps
Full-time pipeline engineering depth may be weaker than dedicated bioinformatics applicants
resume_tailoring: Use a computational/translational CV
Quantify datasets and pipelines
State R/Python and reproducible workflow skills clearly
Do not spend much resume space on chip fabrication
jobs.immediate_action_now: Treat this as a secondary application after Moderna if a computational pivot is genuinely desired. Tailor heavily; do not reuse the complex-in-vitro-model resume.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Organoid and Tissue Systems
jobs.company_info: Conception is developing human reproductive biology platforms using induced pluripotent stem cells and advanced organoid/tissue systems.
jobs.job_description: Senior scientist role developing and applying organoid and tissue systems within an iPSC-based reproductive-biology platform.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD
Postdoctoral training or equivalent industry experience
Typically 3+ years post-PhD experience
Strong organoid and complex tissue-system expertise
jobs.why_good_match: Scientifically, the organoid/tissue-system component is highly aligned. The major mismatch is seniority and the switch from intestinal disease to reproductive/iPSC biology.
gaps_or_risks: Explicit post-PhD experience requirement
Limited direct reproductive biology and iPSC experience
Senior title may make screening rigid
resume_tailoring: Lead with organoid platform development
Explain transferability of complex tissue-model principles
Signal openness to Scientist-level consideration rather than pretending the seniority gap does not exist
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply only if Conception appears flexible on leveling; otherwise track the company for Scientist-level organoid openings.

briefings.overall_takeaway: The market signal this week is unusually clear: the strongest lane is complex human in vitro model/platform development, with biofabrication and microfluidics as differentiators. Bioinformatics is viable, but the best computational roles require treating it as the primary profession rather than an auxiliary skill. No Cleveland-area industry role met the threshold this week.

briefings.title: Industry Role Shortlist

scope.geography: United States; Cleveland/Ohio prioritized first, then nationwide
focus: Organ-on-chip and complex in vitro/preclinical models
scope.selection_rule: Only current roles worth serious attention; older dated records are retained unchanged for trend tracking.

candidate_profile_snapshot.headline: Biomedical engineering PhD candidate integrating experimental biology, CFD, bioinformatics, human organ-chip systems, patient-derived organoids, host-microbiome models, microfabrication, and 3D printing.
core_strengths: Patient-derived intestinal organoids and inflammatory disease models
NAMs, assay development, imaging and quantitative wet-lab biology

jobs.title: Toxicology Research Scientist
jobs.company_info: Vertex is a global biotechnology company; this Predictive and Investigative Safety Assessment role develops human-relevant models for toxicology and therapeutic development.
jobs.posting_status: Active at scan time; closes today
jobs.job_description: Lead development of advanced 3D organoid models, organ-on-a-chip technologies and fit-for-purpose assays to investigate toxicological mechanisms and support discovery/development programs.
key_must_have_requirements: Track record with complex in vitro models
Primary-cell and/or immune-cell work in 3D or co-culture systems
Ability to develop and apply mechanistic toxicity assays
Independent experimental design, interpretation and communication
jobs.why_good_match: This is almost a direct conversion of the organ-chip/NAM portfolio into biopharma safety science: complex human models, organoids, co-culture, quantitative assays and mechanism-focused interpretation are central rather than peripheral.
gaps_or_risks: Direct regulated toxicology/safety-assessment experience may be limited
Primary immune-cell toxicology may be less developed than epithelial model expertise
resume_tailoring: Lead with human-relevant preclinical model development
Frame radiation/ROS studies as mechanistic injury and safety-assessment work
Keep CFD/fabrication as differentiators after the biological model story
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply today before the August 28 close. Use a NAM/toxicology-forward resume and make organ-on-chip, organoids, 3D co-culture and mechanistic injury assays visible in the first half page.

jobs.title: Senior / Principal Scientist, Lung Modeling - Complex in vitro Systems Laboratory
jobs.company_info: Genentech's Complex in vitro Systems Laboratory develops human complex in vitro models to support Development Sciences, Research and Translational Medicine.
jobs.posting_status: Current listing still surfaced and crawled August 27
jobs.job_description: Design, develop, execute and characterize cutting-edge lung complex in vitro models to support drug development, translational research and safety evaluation.
key_must_have_requirements: Deep hands-on complex in vitro model development
Independent model design and characterization
Strong cross-functional scientific leadership
Ability to translate advanced in vitro systems into development decisions
jobs.why_good_match: The scientific fit is excellent: building, validating and interrogating organ-chip/organoid systems is exactly the user's strongest niche. The main problem is level, not content.
gaps_or_risks: Senior/Principal level may expect substantial post-PhD or industry tenure
Lung biology is a new tissue system
resume_tailoring: Present research as independent platform programs rather than thesis chapters
Quantify model performance, reproducibility and validation
Signal openness to appropriate leveling
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply as a high-value stretch only if the posting permits plausible leveling. In the cover letter, explicitly state interest in the CiS platform and openness to a Scientist/Senior Scientist level aligned with experience.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - 3D Bioprinting
jobs.company_info: Polbionica develops integrated 3D-bioprinting and regenerative-medicine technologies and is expanding its U.S. presence at LabCentral.

salary.note: Current listing range; posting remains open into October.

jobs.job_description: Hands-on biotechnology and regenerative-medicine R&D centered on 3D bioprinting, cell culture, biomaterials and tissue engineering; prior dedicated bioprinting experience is not required for strong adjacent candidates.
key_must_have_requirements: Hands-on life-science laboratory background
Cell culture, tissue engineering, biomaterials or adjacent biotechnology experience
Ability and motivation to learn new fabrication technologies
jobs.why_good_match: This remains the cleanest route for turning 3D printing and microfabrication into a primary professional asset while preserving wet-lab tissue engineering.
gaps_or_risks: Direct bioink formulation may be limited
Dedicated bioprinting experience is less extensive than microfluidic fabrication
resume_tailoring: Use a fabrication-forward resume
Attach or link a one-page visual portfolio
Pair every fabrication bullet with its biological purpose or validation
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply with the visual fabrication portfolio rather than a text-only resume package.

jobs.title: Senior Laboratory Scientist - 3D Bioprinting & Tissue Engineering
jobs.company_info: CTIBIOTECH USA is a Philadelphia-based preclinical CRDMO developing 3D tissue and precision-medicine platforms.
jobs.job_description: Senior laboratory role supporting 3D bioprinting and tissue-engineering programs within a preclinical CRDMO environment focused on predictive human tissue models.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong hands-on tissue-engineering laboratory experience
Ability to run and optimize advanced 3D culture/fabrication workflows
Experimental rigor, documentation and cross-project execution
preferred_requirements: Preclinical service or translational R&D environment
jobs.why_good_match: It combines advanced human tissue models, fabrication and preclinical delivery—three areas already present in the portfolio—and is closer to applied translational R&D than a conventional academic tissue-engineering job.
gaps_or_risks: Senior title may imply operational leadership
Direct bioprinting and CRDMO client-delivery experience may be limited
resume_tailoring: Emphasize reproducibility, SOP-minded execution and platform ownership
Show fabricated systems visually
Use preclinical/NAM language rather than academic thesis language
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply this week; the posting is fresh. Position yourself as a human-model platform scientist who can fabricate, culture and validate—not merely as a 3D-printing user.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, In Vitro Cardiometabolic Disease
jobs.company_info: Merck's South San Francisco research laboratory is hiring a hands-on in-vitro scientist for cardiometabolic target identification, validation and therapeutic development.

salary.note: Salary not surfaced in the source used for this scan.

jobs.job_description: Independently design, execute, analyze and interpret complex in-vitro studies supporting target identification, validation and therapeutic programs in metabolic and endocrine disease.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong hands-on in-vitro biology/biochemistry/pharmacology
Independent experimental design and interpretation
Ability to support exploratory and pipeline programs
jobs.why_good_match: The tissue area differs, but the core job is model-and-assay development plus mechanistic interpretation—highly transferable from gut-chip disease modeling.
gaps_or_risks: Senior Scientist level
No direct cardiometabolic specialization
Drug-discovery experience may trail industry candidates
resume_tailoring: De-emphasize device engineering
Lead with mechanistic disease biology and assay development
Translate organ-chip work into target/pathway and decision-enabling experimental language
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply only with an assay-development/translational-biology resume; do not use the fabrication-heavy version.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Scientist
jobs.company_info: Celcuity is a clinical-stage biotechnology company using molecular and functional analysis to develop targeted cancer therapies.
jobs.posting_status: Current listing posted August 2 and crawled August 22
jobs.job_description: Execute bioinformatics studies with wet-lab and clinical teams, interpret complex experimental and clinical datasets, and implement reproducible analysis workflows using modern pipeline tooling.
key_must_have_requirements: Bioinformatics analysis of complex biological datasets
Collaboration with wet-lab scientists
Reproducible analysis and documentation
Ability to communicate results to multidisciplinary teams
preferred_requirements: Experimental-model selection and translational data integration
jobs.why_good_match: This is more credible than a pure software bioinformatics role because it explicitly interfaces with wet-lab scientists and preclinical model selection, where experimental domain knowledge is an advantage.
gaps_or_risks: Pipeline-engineering depth may be lighter than dedicated bioinformaticians
Cancer domain is newer
Nextflow/Snakemake/Docker experience should not be implied unless actually used
resume_tailoring: State concrete datasets, languages and workflows
Show where bioinformatics changed experimental interpretation
Keep organ-chip work as biological-domain credibility rather than the headline
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply if a computational pivot remains attractive. Audit the resume for reproducibility/tooling claims first and remove anything you cannot defend in a technical screen.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist - Organoids & Organ-on-Chip Research
jobs.company_info: ATCC provides biological materials and advanced model services; this federal-program role centers on microphysiological systems, organoids and technology transfer.

salary.note: Salary not surfaced in the source used for this scan.

jobs.posting_status: Current listing still surfaced with an October closing window
jobs.job_description: Lead experimental research across microphysiological systems, organoids and advanced cellular models, mentor staff, direct cross-functional projects and support technology transfer.
key_must_have_requirements: Advanced cellular-model expertise
Independent project leadership
Strong scientific documentation and data interpretation
Ability to mentor and transfer technology
jobs.why_good_match: The technical content is almost perfectly aligned with organ-chip, organoids, model standardization and multidisciplinary platform work. Seniority and program-leadership expectations are the main obstacles.
gaps_or_risks: Senior-level leadership expectation
Federal-program/technology-transfer experience may be limited
resume_tailoring: Present platform work as transferable technology
Highlight mentoring and SOP/protocol development
Quantify reproducibility and validation wherever possible
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply as a stretch if the experience floor is flexible; otherwise use ATCC as a company target for Scientist-level advanced-model openings.

briefings.overall_takeaway: No Cleveland/Ohio industry role cleared the bar this week. The best actionable signal is Vertex's organoid/organ-on-chip toxicology role, which closes today. New 3D-bioprinting hiring at CTIBIOTECH strengthens biofabrication as a real secondary lane, while Genentech and ATCC reinforce that complex in vitro/MPS work remains the strongest scientific fit even when seniority is the obstacle.
